fidelityReview.scope: Detailed primary-reference exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Operator, architect and roof engineer references constrain the105x68m playing field, three double-tier stands,2009 low telescopic D stand, eight-storey corner offices,140x94m retractable-roof system and13 steel girders at about35m operating height. Concrete bays, tier row inventory, glass stair radii, member sections and fabric folds are reconstructed from primary photographs. Scope is static open-roof exterior; private interiors, sponsor art and mechanism animation are excluded. This is not a fabrication survey.
